modal.fileNameNoPathSeparators: Enter a file name only. Select the folder above.
modal.suffixAsTitle: The name after the date becomes the file title (#).
modal.allDayDesc: Removes the start and end times and shows this as an all-day event.
modal.eventTimeDesc: A range note runs from the start date and time to the end date and time. Reminder times are saved separately.
modal.endTimeRequiresStart: Enter a start time before setting an end time.
modal.rangeEndTimeRequired: Enter both a start and end time for a date range, or leave both empty for an all-day range.
modal.endTimeBeforeStart: End time must be on or after start time.
modal.notifyTimeDesc: Local time on the event day (saved as notify_minutes in frontmatter). Leave empty for no reminder.
modal.repeatDesc: Choose a calendar and repeat interval in days, weeks, months, or years.
modal.repeatIntervalDesc: Enter how many days, weeks, months, or years between repeats (a whole number from 1 to 999).
modal.repeatIntervalInvalid: Repeat interval must be a whole number from 1 to 999.
modal.repeatUntilDateDesc: Optional. Repeat occurrences on this date are included.
modal.repeatUntilBeforeStart: The repeat end date must be on or after the start date.
modal.chipColorTitle: Event color (hex, RGB, or color name)
modal.dateChangeConflict: A file already exists for that date.
modal.invalidDateFileName: Use a valid date file name, such as 2026-02-27 or 2026-02-27-meeting.
modal.invalidRangeFileName: Use a valid range file name, such as 2026-02-27--2026-03-01 or 2026-02-27--2026-03-01-trip.
modal.invalidDateRange: End date must be on or after start date.
modal.invalidMonthYear: Enter a month from 1 to 12 and a year from 1900 to 2100.
settings.plannerFolderDesc: Default folder for new planner notes. When the scan scope is limited, Diary looks for notes only in this folder.
settings.plannerFileScopeDesc: Choose whether Diary finds planner notes across the whole vault or only inside the planner folder.
settings.monthLabelsDesc: Display format for month headers (1월–12월 or Jan–Dec)
settings.showHolidaysDesc: Display public holidays in the yearly planner
settings.alternateCalendarDesc: Choose one extra calendar to display in planner views.
settings.calendarOverlayDesc: Show dates from another calendar alongside planner dates. Note filenames follow the Date formats settings; their date values remain Gregorian.
settings.calendarOverlayModeDesc: Choose one built-in or custom calendar to display alongside planner dates.
settings.customCalendarsDesc: Create calendars stored on your device for fantasy worlds or campaigns.
settings.customCalendarEmpty: No custom calendars yet. Create one to define your own months and weekdays.
settings.customCalendarFilesStayGregoria: The secondary calendar only changes the extra dates shown in planners. Note filenames follow the Date formats settings; their date values remain Gregorian.
settings.customCalendarPreviewUnavailabl: Enter valid calendar settings to see a preview.
settings.customCalendarEpochSectionDesc: Match one Gregorian date to one date in the custom calendar.
settings.customCalendarStructureDesc: Set the number of days in each month and the repeating weekday sequence.
settings.customCalendarShortNameDesc: Shown in compact planner cells and dropdowns.
settings.customCalendarEpochDateDesc: The Gregorian date that matches the custom calendar date below.
settings.customCalendarEpochWeekdayDesc: Enter the weekday number for the reference date. The first weekday in the list below is 1.
settings.customCalendarMonthsDesc: One per line: name | short name | days
settings.customCalendarWeekdaysDesc: One per line: name | short name
settings.customCalendarInvalid: The custom calendar settings are invalid.
settings.externalCalendarsDesc: Show read-only events from webcal:// or .ics URLs. Files are created only when you select an event and create a Markdown note.
settings.externalCalendarReadOnlyNote: External calendar events have a dashed outline. No vault files are created until you create a Markdown note.
settings.externalCalendarAddDesc: Add a published iCalendar feed URL.
settings.externalCalendarRefreshAllDesc: Refresh every enabled external calendar feed now.
settings.externalCalendarAutoRefreshDesc: Unless set to manual only, Diary refreshes once when Obsidian starts or the plugin reloads, then refreshes after the selected interval.
settings.externalCalendarUrlDesc: Use a webcal:// URL or an https:// .ics URL.
settings.externalCalendarUrlInvalid: Use a webcal:// or https:// calendar URL.
settings.externalCalendarConnectionSecti: Set the calendar URL and the name and color to show in planners.
settings.externalCalendarSyncSectionDesc: Choose whether to fetch event descriptions and how often to refresh.
settings.externalCalendarDisplaySectionD: Choose which planner views should show this feed.
settings.externalCalendarPrivacy: Secret iCal URLs can grant calendar access to anyone with the link. Diary stores the URL in local plugin data, which may sync with your vault.
settings.mobileBottomPaddingDesc: Minimum space (rem) below mobile planners. Diary also leaves room for Obsidian's standard or floating bottom navigation.
settings.mobileCellWidthDesc: Width of month cells on mobile, in rem. Set to 0 to use the default (4.5rem or 4rem, depending on screen width).
settings.feedbackDesc: Opens GitHub in your browser. A GitHub account is required, and submitted issues are public.

settings.weekStartDesc: Choose the first day in the monthly calendar.
settings.yearlyPlanNotePathDesc: Optional vault-relative path using YYYY and [literal text]. Leave blank to use the yearly creation default in the planner folder. Existing path templates keep their previous meaning until edited.
settings.yearlyPlanNotePathError: Enter a relative .md path with YYYY and optional [literal text], without month or day tokens.
settings.monthlyPlanNotePathError: Enter a relative .md path with YYYY and MM and optional [literal text], without day tokens.
settings.monthlyPlanNotePathDesc: Optional vault-relative path using YYYY, MM and [literal text], such as Notes/YYYY-[M]MM.md. Leave blank to use the monthly creation default in the planner folder. Existing path templates keep their previous meaning until edited.
settings.dateFormatsDesc: Add filename formats for Diary to recognize, and choose a default for each note type. Use YYYY, MM and DD; put literal text in brackets, such as YYYY-[M]MM-DD. Existing files keep their names.
settings.dateFormatDefaultDesc: New notes use this format. All listed formats are recognized. If a monthly or yearly note path is set, that path takes priority.
settings.dateFormatInvalid: Use the required date tokens for this note type and [literal text]. Formats must be distinct, with no folders or .md extension.
settings.dateFormatAmbiguous: {count} filenames match more than one format. These notes are hidden from planners until the conflicting formats are resolved.
settings.dateFormatRemoveAffected: {count} notes currently use this format. Removing it may hide them from planners. Their files will remain in the vault.
settings.colorPaletteDesc: Link notes to named colors. Changing a palette color updates every linked note; fixed colors remain independent. Archive an entry to hide it from new selections and preserve existing links.
settings.colorPaletteArchivedDesc: Archived. Existing linked notes keep this color.
settings.holidayColorDesc: Use the theme color, a fixed color, or a linked palette entry for holiday badges, dots and backgrounds.
settings.linkExistingColorsDesc: Select unlinked notes with color {color} to link to “{name}”. Only selected notes will change.
settings.manageLinkedColorsDesc: Select notes linked to “{name}” ({color}) to move to another entry or keep the current color as a fixed value.
settings.colorLinkEmpty: No matching notes in the current scan scope.
colors.linkedDescription: Linked notes follow this palette color.
colors.fixedDescription: This color applies only to this note.
colors.inheritDescription: Uses the color of the recurring source note.
colors.invalid: Enter a hexadecimal color such as #3b82f6.
planNote.multipleExisting: Multiple notes match this period. Choose a note to open.
dateFormats.ambiguousFilename: This filename matches multiple date formats. Change it so that it matches only one format.
settings.planNotePathExists: An existing note uses this path.
settings.planNotePathBlocked: A folder blocks this note path.
settings.planNotePathNew: No note exists at this path yet.
